findings.finding: The company has a record of holding its full-year plan at H1 even on very high progress and revising only at Q3: FY26 H1 経常 697 was 58.1% of the then plan with no revision (stock -3.62% next session), and the +20% revision came at Q3 on 2026-01-28 (stock -4.87%, kabutan: '上方修正も織り込み済み'); FY27's Q1 短信 again said no change. A hold at this H1 against an IFIS number 17% above plan is the base case, and on this name the H1 hold drew sellers last year.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: IFIS has sat above plan for 4 weeks so the hold is no surprise to analysts, and the stock is already 9% off its 10/16 high. What would look different if fully priced: the stock would not have run from ~3,000 to 4,110 after Q1 on the 'conservative plan' story; the residual is that some holders still own it for an H1 revision that this company's history says usually waits for Q3.
findings.independence: Revision timeline from kabutan's 修正履歴 (FY26: 初 25/05/09, 修 26/01/28, 実 26/05/08; no H1 修) https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3850 and kabuyoho progress table (H1 FY26 経常 697 = 58.1%) https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=3850 — same facts, different aggregators.

findings.finding: Q1 FY27 OP 384 (+29.4%) and 経常 397 beat the IFIS Q1 estimate of 320, and 経常 progress of 26.7% was above the 5-year average of 21.5%; if Q2 grows OP at even ~20% on last year's strong 388 base, H1 OP lands near 850-870, roughly 1-3% above the consensus-implied ~840 and ~59% of the company plan, which kabutan will headline as high progress.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Strong progress with plan held: +4.67% at Q1 FY27, -3.62% at H1 FY26; mixed, so this line is sized small.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the Q1 beat is public and IFIS already carries 1,730. The unpriced part is only whether Q2 holds the Q1 growth rate against a high-margin (12.4%) Q2 FY26 comparison; nothing public (no 月次 at this company) shows Q2.
findings.independence: kabuyoho/IFIS Q1 consensus 320 vs actual 397 https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=3850; Q1 短信 (sales +14.1%, software +9.0%, services +18.3%, contract liabilities up) https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260729/140120260727500130.pdf

findings.finding: 光通信 group sold 51,000 shares (9.53% -> 8.50%) by 2026-10-19, apparently into the 10/16 high (72,500-share day), and still holds 421,300 shares, about 20 sessions of current volume, so a seller is in the register and not finished; a print that does not lift the stock gives it liquidity to keep selling.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print with a disclosed seller; the 2025 光通信 exit (below 5% on 2025-09-26) preceded the H1 FY26 print that fell -3.62%, one case only.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: filed 10/26 after the close, and on 10/28 the stock is -3.5% against a +1.4% Nikkei on low volume, which looks like the market absorbing it. Residual is only the overhang's effect on the print-day bid.

findings.finding: The May 2026 mid-term plan sets a 35% payout and a 40% total-return target (implying buybacks), FY28 OP target 2.7bn, and Q1 cash rose to 4.5bn yen; no buyback has been announced yet, so a 自社株買い with H1 results is possible but not signalled.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Dividend raise (+16 yen FY26, +9 yen FY27 guide) announced at the FY print 2026-05-08; no buyback ever announced in the window checked. No H1 dividend (0 yen).
findings.why_not_priced: A low-probability optional upside: the 5-point gap between payout and total-return targets is roughly 50-60m yen a year, small against a 18.6bn yen cap, so even if announced it is modest; nothing in the price or the board chatter anticipates it.

outside_window.finding: Likely upward revision of the FY27 plan toward the IFIS 1,700 OP at Q3 (late January 2027), following the FY26 pattern.
